dialogues.speaker: Wactana
dialogues.text: "I have neither goals I must reach, nor have I urgent desires. I am a happy shepherd. I care only for alpacas, for the seasons and things that grow, for the cool breeze and rains..."

response.speaker: Wactana
response.text: That I have the life I enjoy now is all thanks to his sense of responsibility. Speaking of his name, I did plan to call him something more normal...

response.speaker: Wactana
response.text: Back then, I was friends with a chef from Sumeru, and was trying all kinds of creative dishes, so I thought of naming him for some kind of food.

response.speaker: Wactana
response.text: Now he might look pretty fierce, but he's a sweetie on the inside, and occasionally makes a few harmless mistakes when he gets too reckless... Yeah, "Half-Baked" fits his vibe just fine!

response.speaker: Wactana
response.text: Floofy and furry, they're super cute! Sometimes, when I really wanna take an afternoon nap, I use them for pillows, and it feels like... That must be what it feels like to sleep on a cloud, right?

response.speaker: Wactana
response.text: Hmm... Maybe their fleece could be used to make pillows or cushions...

choices.text: I'll leave you to it, then.

response.speaker: Wactana
response.text: Here's wishing you a peaceful and pleasant day!
